title: Stancu-Type Generalizations of Neural Network Operators with Perturbed Sampling Nodes
summary: In this paper, we introduce a Stancu-type generalization of multivariate neural network operators (NNOs) by incorporating two parameters that perturb the sampling nodes. The proposed operators extend the existing NNOs by allowing flexibility in the placement of sampling nodes. We establish the well-definedness and boundedness of the operators and prove uniform convergence on compact domains. Furthermore, quantitative error estimates are derived in terms of the modulus of continuity, leading to a convergence rate result.
